description: Generate a new wallet keypair for the given chain, encrypt it with a password, and save it to the local keystore (~/.printr/wallets.json). Returns the new address and wallet ID. The wallet is immediately set as the active wallet for its chain type. Fund the address with native tokens before signing transactions.

password.description: Password used to encrypt the private key at rest (minimum 12 characters)

name: printr_wallet_new

wallet_id.description: Keystore wallet ID — use with printr_wallet_unlock
